property_summary: The new EmergencyOracle is always deployed with msg.sender as its owner.
After newEmergencyOracle(string) is called by the jojoTeam, the owner of the new EmergencyOracle is the caller (msg.sender).
The owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle equals the caller of newEmergencyOracle.
After a successful newEmergencyOracle(string) call, the emitted NewEmergencyOracle event contains the caller's address as the first argument (the owner parameter).
after calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the default EmergencyOracle (the one that would be created by a direct call with msg.sender) equals the caller's address
The event NewEmergencyOracle always emits the address of msg.sender as the first argument.
When newEmergencyOracle is called, the first event argument equals the caller's address.
The address stored in jojoTeam must remain unchanged after calling newEmergencyOracle.
The address of the caller (msg.sender) is the first argument of the NewEmergencyOracle event emitted by newEmergencyOracle.
The event NewEmergencyOracle always emits the address 'address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(0))))' as its first argument.
